Dear Gary,

I hope this email finds you well. My name is Marcos Gonzalez and I am the Managing Attorney at GovSpring Legal, a law firm uniquely dedicated to supporting government contractors through complex regulatory landscapes. It looks like ACM deals with several regulatory requirements unique to food preparation for the federal government, including domestic sourcing and inspection requirements. I wanted to ask if you have experienced friction with the government regarding either of these regulatory requirements. We help federal contractors maintain compliance with federal regulations and strategically respond to performance issues that may jeopardize your federal business.

I would appreciate the opportunity to introduce our services and discuss how GovSpring Legal can serve as a strategic partner to you and your General Counsel as you lead American Custom Meats into its next chapter. Let me know if you would like to discuss any legal issues, free of charge. I'm available next week, and you can schedule a call here or call me at (202) 407-3556. You can also read more about my associate and I on our webpage.

I have CC'd my associate and my law clerk, who would also participate in any scheduled call.

Best,
Marcos Gonzalez
Managing Attorney
GovSpring Legal
